description: The PROGRAM-ID RECURSIVE attribute - a 2002 introduction. Folded from the inline BinderDriver gate (Exec Step E). THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): the 1985 PROGRAM-ID paragraph assigns only the COMMON and INITIAL attributes (§1985:X.3.1.2; 'The COMMON clause specifies that the program is common', §1985:X.3.1.4 GR2; 'The INITIAL clause specifies that the program is initial', GR3); the 2002 Format 1 adds RECURSIVE (§2002:11.9.1): 'The RECURSIVE clause specifies that the program and any programs contained within it are recursive. The program may be called while it is active and may call itself' (§2002:11.9.3 GR4; the RECURSIVE/INITIAL exclusion is §2002:11.9.2 SR6), and §2002:F.2 item 14 records 'CALL recursively. The capability of calling an active COBOL program has been added to COBOL'. 2014 keeps it (§2014:11.10.3 GR4).
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. RWREC IS RECURSIVE.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    STOP RUN.
